name: desktop-tauri
author: marlon-chaviano
title: Desktop app with Tauri
description: A small, fast desktop app with Tauri 2: a React + Vite interface and a Rust backend, with mobile targets available. Installers a fraction of Electron's size.
instructions:
## How to work here

- The UI is a React app in `src/`; the native side is Rust in `src-tauri/src/`. They talk through commands: a `#[tauri::command]` function in Rust, registered in `invoke_handler`, called from React with `invoke("name", { args })`.
- Permissions are explicit: every plugin or API the UI uses must be allowed in `src-tauri/capabilities/`. Grant the minimum.
- Heavy or privileged work (files, the network with secrets, the OS) goes in Rust commands; the UI never gets more access than it needs.
- Start with `npm run tauri dev`; build installers with `npm run tauri build`. Needs Rust (rustup) and the platform prerequisites from tauri.app.
- Before finishing: `npm run build` and `cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`.
